fact: Cassava and Vodafone Egypt recently announced an AI factory initiative giving businesses and government organizations locally hosted AI infrastructure through GPU-as-a-service, and in June 2026 the telecom regulator licensed Hassan Allam Data Centers, whose Hassan Allam Utilities and A15 agreed a new data center of about $400 million.
title: From Enablement to Execution, Egypt's AI Ecosystem Reaches Production Scale
